minutes.headline: Committee named itself the TCP Building Design Committee and targeted December 4 to review a draft designer RFQ.
minutes.summary: The committee approved prior minutes, confirmed its vice chair and secretary, and settled on its name. It reviewed its charge from the town meeting article, earlier space studies and building options, the need to separate the building parcel from the school campus, and the designer selection timeline with the town manager. Meeting dates and times were adjusted and community outreach was discussed.

what_happened.line: The committee voted to name itself the TCP Building Design Committee.
Members set a target of reviewing and approving a draft designer RFQ at the December 4 meeting.
Members noted the town meeting article funds design and engineering, not construction, and that no specific design budget exists yet.
The existing building report and related studies will go to members and onto a future agenda for review.

why_it_matters: The committee is at the start of a process that could lead to a town building project, and the design budget it is expected to develop would come before voters at a later town meeting.
Separating the building parcel from the school campus and choosing a designer are early steps that shape later cost, and residents can comment at meetings.
